content.title: 7. Living in Siena – INTERNATIONAL ADMISSIONS @ UNIVERSITY OF SIENA
content.text: Siena is a historic city located in the region of Tuscany in central Italy. It is situated about 70 kilometers (43 miles) south of Florence, the capital of Tuscany, and approximately 230 kilometers (143 miles) north of Rome, Italy’s capital.
